blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden market stall dedicated to selling seafood. It features a sturdy brown timber frame with four corner posts and a sagging green-and-beige striped canvas awning. The main wooden display counter is stocked with silvery fish, an orange-red crab, a small wooden bucket of dark shellfish, and dried fish wrapped or stacked on the side. Sitting on the ground in front are a wooden wash-tub style barrel filled with fish and a round woven basket packed with shellfish/fish. All geometry is solid, stylized, and continuous with no floating or broken meshes.
blind.from_above: A rectangular canopy of green and beige stripes framed by four corner post tops, with two circular containers (a bucket and a basket) visible protruding along the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching just below the shoulder/head of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure) and about 5 feet wide.
